hand Berlin

International Forum on Robotic Hands & Applications
15–16 June 2027 | Berlin, Germany

 

This is hand Berlin

Connect with engineers, procurement professionals and R&D leaders at hand Berlin to showcase your solutions, meet potential customers and partners, and explore business opportunities. hand Berlin brings together international experts, manufacturers, suppliers, users and research institutions across the dexterous hand industry, covering the development, manufacturing, integration and application of dexterous hand technologies. The event also serves as a marketplace for presenting products, systems and components, exchanging technical expertise and exploring business cooperation.

Who should attend

  • Researchers, engineers and developers working on dexterous hand design, sensing, control and manipulation

  • Manufacturers and suppliers of actuators, transmission systems, sensors, materials and robotic components

  • Developers of robotic control, manipulation learning, simulation and AI solutions

  • Industry professionals, system integrators and users in manufacturing, humanoid robotics, logistics, prosthetics and assistive technologies

 

Focal Topics

include, but are not limited to:

Dexterous Hand Products & Systems

Showcasing dexterous hand products and complete systems, with live demonstrations.

Components, Technologies & Supply Chain

Focused on key components, technologies and products, including joint mechanisms, actuation and transmission systems, sensing technologies, structural materials, flexible mechanisms, embedded electronics and power management.

Gripping Technologies & End-of-Arm Tooling

Covering gripping technologies and end-of-arm products related to dexterous hand development and robotic manipulation, including adaptive and soft grippers, multi-finger grippers, specialized end effectors and interchangeable tools.

Control, Manipulation & Intelligence

This topic explores technologies that enable dexterous hands to perceive, control and manipulate objects. It addresses motion and force control, intelligent manipulation, teleoperation and simulation, as well as learning-based approaches for adaptive manipulation.

Systems Integration & Custom Development

Dedicated to integrating dexterous hands into robotic systems and platforms, with an emphasis on platform interoperability, compatibility and customer-specific development.

Applications & Deployment

Centered on applications of dexterous hands in smart manufacturing, logistics, humanoid robotics, prosthetics and assistive technologies, as well as real-world use in industrial, rehabilitation and human–robot interaction settings.
